hypothesis: A small EML branch corrects a SiLU student's errors more efficiently than a matched SiLU branch.

budget.accounting: Sum of wall seconds of our GPU subprocesses including startup and shared-device contention. Sequential jobs on one selected H100, no process termination except our own timed-out child.

training.objective: Equal arithmetic/language weighting of normalized raw MLP MSE plus native normalized contribution MSE
training.initialization: Same train-only ridge affine map, encoder PCA, and residual decoder basis; zero branch readouts. Both gated correction types start at gate 0.01.
training.checkpoint: Lowest development activation objective, ties retain earlier checkpoint. No activation-specific tuning, extra depth, or longer training.

development.selection: First records in the previously frozen development files, never selected by model correctness; all original selection activations are development.

gate.rule: Hybrid must improve both activation errors by at least 2% over BOTH SiLU and SiLU+SiLU; each arithmetic operation, shifted arithmetic, and ARC accuracy must be no more than 2pp worse than either control; CE must be no more than 0.01 nats worse than either. Pooled ordinary arithmetic accuracy must improve by at least 1pp over BOTH controls. All four fits must complete. Otherwise stop, retain all results, and do not open confirmation.

confirmation.source: Previously sealed architecture confirmation files, never evaluated in the prior study; hashes frozen before hybrid training
confirmation.rule: Only if screen passes: train all four arms for seeds 2207 and 3301 at identical effort, then freeze all 12 checkpoints before opening confirmation. Evaluate original, all arms/all seeds, and ablated hybrid/all seeds. No tuning on confirmation. If remaining budget cannot accommodate all work, report incomplete confirmation, no success claim.

acceptance.rule: An EML-specific benefit requires consistent positive pooled arithmetic gains versus BOTH controls in all three seeds, with paired group-bootstrap 95% lower bounds above zero, no endpoint accuracy loss beyond 1pp or CE increase beyond 0.01 nats at the corresponding upper bound, and ablation worsening arithmetic quality in every seed. Exploratory intervals are unadjusted; no deployment acceptance or mechanism claims.

benchmark.placement: Native SDPA, CPU PLE table for all arms; all executed transformer blocks on CUDA. Staged comparison MLPs on CPU outside timing. Same affine folding for all students. No compilation.
benchmark.scope: Installed replacement, synchronized CUDA and wall timing. Loading and tokenization excluded. Report prefill, decode, throughput, memory, and end-to-end separately. Shared-GPU timing cannot establish isolated serving latency.

diagnostics: Remove correction branch after training; gate magnitude alone is not evidence
Measure trained decoder's outside-subspace residual and remaining training-distribution affine-plus-rank-512 bound
FP32 folded equivalence and BF16 reconstruction drift
Record late checkpoint selection and gradient clipping; no claim to distinguish optimization from capacity without further controls
scope: A capped hybrid screen within the affine-shortcut architecture. Its nonlinear encoder and decoder remain rank limited. No arithmetic-mechanism discovery. Original MLP must not execute in any replacement path. Teacher activations supervise training only. Keep README.md as the only Markdown document.
